outcome.technical: New skills/architecture-map/evals/benchmark/run-candidate.sh (POSIX sh, #!/bin/sh, executable, staged). Usage: run-candidate.sh <run-dir> <ENV_NAME> <prompt-file> (--plugin-dir <dir> | --plugin <name@marketplace> --marketplace <url-or-path>) [--model <model>] [--path-prepend <dir>] [-- <extra claude args>]. It validates the arguments (exit 2 with usage on stderr), makes every path absolute, cds into <run-dir>/repo, replaces <ENV_NAME> in the prompt with the variable name via sed, exports <ENV_NAME>=<run-dir>/repo and runs `env -u CLAUDECODE claude -p <prompt> [--plugin-dir d] [--model m] --output-format stream-json --verbose --setting-sources project --permission-mode auto --permission-prompts none <extras>`. It writes stream.jsonl, stderr.log, exit-code, timing.json {started, finished, total_duration_seconds} (epoch seconds from date +%s) and command.txt, a replayable shell line (cd, the env assignments, the prompt as "$(sed ... <prompt-file>)"); I replayed command.txt with sh -c and got the same argv. The script exits with the session's status. --plugin: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=<run-dir>/config, prints a one-line warning that the directory must be logged in once (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=<dir> claude /login), runs `claude plugin marketplace add <mkt> --scope project` and `claude plugin install <plugin> --scope project` from the repo copy (project scope because the session reads only the project setting source; user-scope enablement would not load under --setting-sources project), output to install.log, and reads the version from `claude plugin list --json` through node into plugin-version.txt ('unknown' as fallback). --path-prepend puts the directory first on PATH for the session only, not for the install commands. Nothing is written outside <run-dir>. The script parses under sh -n, zsh -n and dash -n. scripts/cost-profile.mjs: an Agent/Task call is labelled subagent_type, else description, else unknown-subagent; when result events exist but none carries modelUsage, the reconciliation file entry gets modelUsage:'missing' (and stays matchesModelUsage:null) and the text report adds a line 'reconciliation missing: the result events carry no modelUsage in <file>'; header comment documents both. Output for the existing fixtures is byte-identical to HEAD's script: cmp over text, --json and --json --basename on stream-sample.jsonl, and over text on the same stream with its result events removed. tests/fixtures/cost/expected.json is unchanged (git diff --quiet exit 0). PROTOCOL.md Configurations section now documents the run-candidate.sh usage, its outputs, both modes, --path-prepend and the one-sentence login requirement; the Duration bullet in Metrics now says timing.json is the clock read around the session, not the result event. New fixture tests/fixtures/cost/foreign-stream.jsonl: 12 synthetic events with Task subagent_type code-cartographer, a Task with only a description, an Agent diagram-drafter, opus and sonnet, and a final result whose input and cache classes reconcile. Tests: c18-c21 in tests/cost-profile.test.mjs and b10-b14 in tests/benchmark.test.mjs (b13/b14 drive the script against a stub claude on PATH). Before the fix c19, c20 and c21 failed and c18 passed; c18 locks behaviour the current code already had. b10-b14 all failed before the script existed. Commands: `node --test tests/denylist.test.mjs tests/benchmark.test.mjs tests/cost-profile.test.mjs` exit 0, 37/37 pass, 0 skipped. Full `node --test` exit 0, 476/476 pass. Dependents: docs/architecture/architecture.model.json and archmap.html name the path only (unchanged); scripts/pipeline.mjs:1277 and scripts/usage.mjs:191 mention it in prose (still correct); tests/readme.test.mjs and tests/evals.test.mjs check the documented `--json --basename` command (unchanged CLI); tests/skill.test.mjs s17 runs it over orchestrator turns (green in the full run); tests/cost-profile.test.mjs and tests/benchmark.test.mjs are this task's. PROTOCOL.md's dependant tests/benchmark.test.mjs b6/b7/b9 pass after the edit. Not committed.
